name: PickFu Insights
tagline: Test a product idea on real shoppers before you build it
description: Describe the choice you are stuck on - a name, a cover image, a price, a feature - and this bot writes a consumer poll around it, puts that in front of a paid PickFu panel, and reads the answers back as a recommendation. The idea is to spend a little on evidence instead of months on a guess.
author: GrokBotMoney
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
